title: FIR Halfband Decimator
text: 使用多相 FIR 半带滤波器对信号进行抽取，输入 1 路、输出 2 路、无直接馈通；按 {Design method} 指定滤波器设计方法；{Filter specification} 指定滤波器设计参数 Transition width and stopband、{Filter order} 指定滤波器阶数、{Transition width (Hz)} 指定过渡带宽 4.1e3、{Stopband attenuation (dB)} 指定阻带衰减、{Numerator} 指定 FIR 半带滤波器系数、{Output highpass subband} 输出高通子带、{Sample rate mode} 用于指定输入采样率的模式 Use normalized、{Input sample rate (Hz)} 指定输入信号的采样率、{Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals} 允许固定大小输入信号的任意帧长度、{View Filter Response} 指定查看滤波器响应、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted、{Rounding mode} 输出定点运算的舍入模式、{Coefficients} 指定系数的字长和小数长度 fixdt，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: 输入信号 column vector | matrix

ports.name: LP
ports.summary: 抽取器输出的低通子带 column vector | matrix

ports.name: HP
ports.summary: 抽取器输出的高通子带 column vector | matrix

params.name: Filter specification
params.values: 滤波器设计参数 Transition width and stopband attenuation (default) | Filter order and transition width | Filter order and stopband attenuation | Coefficients

params.name: Filter order
params.values: 滤波器阶数 52 (default) | even positive integer

params.name: Stopband attenuation (dB)
params.values: 阻带衰减 80 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Numerator
params.values: FIR 半带滤波器系数 designHalfbandFIR(’TransitionWidth’,0.186, ’StopbandAttenuation’,80, ’Structure’,’decim’) (default) | row vector

params.name: Design method
params.values: 滤波器设计方法 Auto (default) | Equiripple | Kaiser

params.name: Output highpass subband
params.values: 输出高通子带 off (default) | on

params.name: Sample rate mode
params.values: 用于指定输入采样率的模式 Use normalized frequency (0 to 1) (default) | Specify on dialog | Inherit from input port

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: 输入信号的采样率 44100 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: 允许固定大小输入信号的任意帧长度 off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 输出定点运算的舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: 系数的字长和小数长度 fixdt(1,16) (default) | fixdt(1,16,0)
